messages.content:
Extract the ticket fields from this customer email. If the email contains no actionable request, set status to not_found and fill the other fields with your best neutral guess.

<email>
Subject: Seats

You billed us for two seats this month but we only have one user. Please correct the invoice.
</email>

request.system: You extract support-ticket fields. Use only what is in the email; never invent details.

requested_by_date.description: ISO date if the customer named a deadline, else null

response.text:
{
  "status": "found",
  "category": "billing",
  "urgency": "medium",
  "product_area": "subscription",
  "requested_by_date": "not_found",
  "summary": "Customer claims they were billed for two seats but only have one user. Request to correct the invoice."
}
